title: UpdAPI run result
description: Outcome of one benchmark run. attempt_status separates a legitimately scored attempt from an invalid experiment (harness/setup/validator malfunction) so apparatus failures can never be counted as model failures. verified_success is decided by the case validator, never an LLM judge. See docs/BENCHMARK_SPEC.md sections 5.4 and 8. schema_version 0.2.0.

attempt_status.description: scored = the agent/control was correctly invoked against a correctly materialized workspace and the validator ran to a verdict (a timeout of a correctly invoked agent is scored=failure). invalid = the experiment itself malfunctioned (corrupted fixture, adapter/wrapper failure, benchmark-side setup missing, validator malfunction); excluded from any score.

invalid_reason.description: Required human-readable cause when attempt_status is invalid.

verified_success.description: Meaningful only when attempt_status is scored; must be false on invalid runs.

initial_stale_use.description: true only when evidence in the implementation/trajectory shows use of the obsolete interface relevant to THIS case. null = not classified. Never inferred from generic failure.

recovered.description: Among runs that demonstrably entered a stale state: did the run end in verified success? null when initial_stale_use is null/false.

tool_trace_summary.description: Counts by tool family (web_search, docs_fetch, shell, edit, ...) when observable.

artifacts.description: Run-relative paths: task prompt, starting hash manifest, final patch, validator log, adapter output, artifact SHA-256 index.
